Minor bug fixes after launch are included within the agreed support period. (1 Month). Does not include third-party/server/platform related issues.

1. Project Workflow

Our standard workflow:

  1. Client Discovery
  2. Asset Handoff
  3. UI/UX Design
  4. Website Development
  5. Testing & Revisions
  6. Launch & Handoff

2. Asset Handoff

Development can only begin after all required assets have been submitted by the client.

Required assets may include:

  • Logo
  • Images/videos
  • Product data
  • Company profile/content
  • Social links
  • Domain/hosting access (if needed)

Delays in asset submission may affect project timeline.

3. Revision Policy

This project includes:

  • 2 Major Review Sessions
  • 1 during UI/UX Design
  • 1 before Final Launch

Additional major revisions outside the agreed sessions may incur extra charges.

4. Estimated Timeline

Phase Estimated Time

  • Discovery & Planning: 2–5 Working Days
  • UI/UX Design: 5–10 Working Days
  • Development: 10–25 Working Days
  • Testing & Launch: 3–7 Working Days

Timeline may vary depending on project complexity and response time.

5. Maintenance Terms

Maintenance fees that have been paid are non-refundable.

Maintenance covers minor updates, monitoring, and technical support only.

Major redesigns or additional features are excluded unless agreed separately.

6. Payment Terms

50% Down Payment (DP) is required before project scheduling and development begins.

Remaining 50% payment must be completed before final handoff and website launch.

Development can only begin after:

  1. DP payment confirmation
  2. Complete asset handoff from client

Late payments may result in project delays or temporary pause in development.

7. Scope Changes

Any additional requests outside the agreed scope may require:

  • Additional charges
  • Timeline adjustments

8. Client Responsibilities

Client is responsible for:

  • Providing accurate content/assets
  • Giving timely feedback
  • Maintaining communication during development

9. Post Launch Support

Minor bug fixes after launch are included within the agreed support period. (1 Month)

Does not include third-party/server/platform related issues.

1. Service Level Agreement (SLA) & Scope

This Agreement governs the maintenance and hosting services provided by Scala. By paying the down payment on the associated invoice, the Client accepts all terms, conditions, and response times outlined below.

2. Support Response Tiers

  • Critical (website offline): Under 2 hours response time, 24/7.
  • Urgent (major feature broken): Under 8 hours response time.
  • Standard (general requests): Under 24 hours response time during business hours.

3. Hosting & Infrastructure

Scala provides secure hosting and maintenance monitoring. The client is allocated resources according to their contracted hosting plan. Any infrastructure usage (bandwidth, storage) exceeding normal allocations will be notified and may result in plan upgrades.

4. IP Ownership

Full Intellectual Property (IP) ownership of the custom developed code is transferred to the Client immediately upon receipt of the final project payment. Scala retains ownership of any pre-existing modules, libraries, or reusable tools used in the development.

5. Suspension of Service

Invoices are net-14. Unpaid invoices past the due date may result in temporary suspension of website hosting and maintenance services, with 7 days prior notice.

PROJECT PROPOSAL & INVOICE

Prepared for our valued client. Review terms, project specifications, and payment terms.

Prepared By: Scala Solutions

Validity: 30 Days from issue
